We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available chemicals, total price <=9999 (we cannot check price but assume buyable). Need to construct route JSON.

Target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

Structure: a tolyl sulfonamide attached to phenyl with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide linking to an aniline (anilide). So we can think disconnection: break sulfonamide S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline. Also break amide C-N bond to give acid chloride and aniline. Also break C=C double bond maybe via Heck? Simpler: two disconnections: 1) sulfonamide formation from sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline (tolyl-amine). The sulfonyl part is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc...). So we need sulfonyl chloride: ClSO2-Ph-... with the phenyl bearing the vinyl amide side chain. That could be made from sulfonyl chloride derived from 4-(E-... )-phenylsulfonyl chloride. Could be commercially available? Possibly not. Alternative: start from sulfonic acid and use coupling reagent.

Maybe easier: use two steps: first form amide via coupling of aniline (c3ccccc3N) with acrylic acid derivative (trans-CH=CH-COOH). Then sulfonylate the aniline of tolyl with sulfonyl chloride derived from phenylacrylic acid? Hmm.

We need leaves commercially available. Let's search for building blocks: 4-methyl aniline (p-toluidine) is buyable. 4-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride? Actually p-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride (p-aminobenzenesulfonyl chloride) is buyable? Might be. But we need sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl with vinyl amide side chain. That is more complex.

Alternative route: start from 4-methyl aniline (p-toluidine) and 4-(E)-3-(4-aminophenyl)acryloyl chloride? Not.

Maybe we can propose three-step route using Suzuki coupling to attach phenyl groups.

Step1: Build the central phenyl-sulfonyl fragment: start from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial) and do Suzuki coupling with 4-methyl phenyl boronic acid to get p-tolyl-sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl? Actually sulfonyl chloride attached to phenyl ring; we need sulfonyl attached to phenyl that also has vinyl amide side chain. Could start from 4-bromo-phenylsulfonyl chloride, then Suzuki coupling with 4-methyl phenyl boronic acid to give target sulfonyl chloride with tolyl attached? Wait target has sulfonyl attached to phenyl (c2ccc(... )cc2) which is attached to tolyl via sulfonamide N. So sulfonyl group is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc...). The N of sulfonamide is attached to tolyl. So we need sulfonyl chloride (Ar-SO2-Cl) where Ar is phenyl bearing vinyl amide side chain. Then react with p-toluidine to give sulfonamide.

Thus step1: Synthesize Ar-SO2-Cl (aryl sulfonyl chloride) from corresponding aryl sulfonic acid (commercial?) maybe 4-(E)-3-(4-aminophenyl)acrylic acid? Actually the side chain is /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. The aryl sulfonyl chloride must have that side chain attached to the phenyl ring (para to sulfonyl). So we need 4-(E)-3-(4-aminophenyl)acryloyl phenyl sulfonyl chloride? That's complex.

Maybe alternative disconnection: break the C=C double bond via retro-aldol? Not.

Given time, we can propose a plausible route using commercially available reagents: 1) Start from p-toluidine (C). 2) Sulfonylate with 4-(E)-3-(4-aminophenyl)acryloyl sulfonyl chloride (maybe not commercial). Might be unrealistic.

We could propose three-step route using protecting groups? Might be okay as answer even if not fully validated.

But we need to ensure leaves are buyable. We can list leaves: p-toluidine, 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride, 4-methyl phenylboronic acid, trans-cinnamic acid, aniline. Need to check buyable.

Let's check buyable for these.
